LanguageData.DMS_SolitaryZPM.label: solidified zero-point energy
LanguageData.DMS_SolitaryZPM.description: Physical energy solidified into a stable material state by a confinement field - one of the transcendent technologies whose working principles humanity has managed to decipher, and the power source of most transcendent artifacts. Most existing human technology, however, cannot make direct use of the energy inside it.
LanguageData.DMS_OccultechKey.label: occultech glyph
LanguageData.DMS_OccultechKey.description: A palm-sized cipher plate in a sealed casing. Each glyph carries one fragment of the authentication key for a stele buried beneath this world. The colonial fleets split every stele's key across several glyphs and scatter them, so no single find can open one.\n\nRead as a full set with qubit decryption, the glyphs resolve where their stele lies and how to break its seal. The reading collapses their quantum states, and the glyphs are spent.
